proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: S↔L: the ref resolves to the library lean/QOU/Braiding/hecke_mass_trace.lean:88, which is self-assuming. Both claims are class fields (`claim_cat_mass_eq_norm_trace`, `claim_trace_decomposition`, l.70-82) and are returned as a pair, with `cat_mass` and `norm` free. The sibling .lean differs: it has no `hecke_mass_trace`, it *defines* the mass as |markovTrace| (lean:127-128), the decomposition is a structure field (l.66-67, 108), and it adds ℝ positivity variants. S↔P: steps 1-4 (prf:1-20) are assertions about τ ("exact and monoidal … norm preservation") rather than an argument. "|·|" on the Laurent ring R is never defined, which is the point the sibling's own two-tier note raises (lean:16-21). The decomposition needs Φ_mass = Φ^desc + ΣΦ^trans_i, which is asserted ("τ … preserves the idempotent splitting", prf:27-28), not shown. Quantum Schur–Weyl gives End_{U_q}(V^⊗n) as a quotient of H_n (TL), not H_n itself (prf:10-11).

trap-triples.evidence: The Archimedean-specialisation sentence lists three readouts, but they are the three objects the R->R realisation actually touches.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: no meta-commentary on the block's own rhetoric

The block-final clause narrates the document's own bookkeeping instead of stating a fact: "...the archimedean (R-valued) readouts of the generic Markov-trace mass data; **the $R\to\mathbb{R}$ realisation is acknowledged here**." "Is acknowledged here" announces that an acknowledgement is being made; the acknowledgement is the sentence itself.
trap-meta-commentary.notes: NOT fixed. The same sentence needs an author decision on a second defect (it names a "categorical mass-squared" that appears nowhere else in the block — the proposition is about the mass, not its square), so a punctuation-level trim would leave the block in a worse half-corrected state. Proposed fix: "**Archimedean specialisation.** The categorical mass, the hyperbolic volume $\mathrm{vol}$, $\hbar$, and the descended trace are the archimedean ($\mathbb{R}$-valued) readouts of the generic Markov-trace mass data." Also: the sibling prop:hecke-markov-transition ends with a near-identical "Archimedean specialisation" paragraph whose "What follows..." has no referent — the two read as sweep-inserted boilerplate and should be checked as a class.

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: No closing restatement of the proposition.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: "The categorical mass-squared, the hyperbolic volume $\mathrm{vol} : \mathbb{R}$ and $\hbar : \mathbb{R}$, and the descended trace are the archimedean ($\mathbb{R}$-valued) readouts of the generic Markov-trace mass data" is a three-item subject list carrying Lean-style TYPE ASCRIPTIONS ("vol : R", "hbar : R") into narrative prose; it parses on the page and stalls aloud, and a reader cannot say "vol colon R" in running text.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: NOT fixed (bundled with the meta-commentary fix above). Proposed fix as given under trap-meta-commentary: drop the ascriptions and let the "(R-valued)" gloss carry the typing.
